from arc_dsl import *

def transform(grid):
    g=[list(r) for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=g[0][0]
    # marker = cell that is neither background nor the fill color 9? general: not bg and not most common interior
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    fill=max((v for v in cnt if v!=bg), key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    def ismark(v): return v!=bg and v!=fill
    hrows=[i for i in range(h) if any(ismark(g[i][j]) for j in range(w))]
    vcols=[j for j in range(w) if any(ismark(g[i][j]) for i in range(h))]
    out=[]
    for a,b in zip(hrows,hrows[1:]):
        row=[]
        for c,d in zip(vcols,vcols[1:]):
            corners=[g[a][c],g[a][d],g[b][c],g[b][d]]
            ms=[v for v in corners if ismark(v)]
            row.append(ms[0] if len(ms)==4 and len(set(ms))==1 else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out
